entities.summary: "I Will Remember" is a 1995 song performed by Toto from their album Tambu. The song was released as a single in Europe that same year to promote the album. Upon its release, "I Will Remember" reached the singles chart in several countries, including the UK, where it peaked number 64. Elsewhere, the song also charted in Germany, the Netherlands, and Germany.
